title: $NET Cloudflare Short Setup
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
Research rating: Strong Sell (high conviction). Cloudflare delivers consistent 29% revenue growth and positive $287M FCF, yet remains unprofitable with -4.7% net margins and rising debt.

* Fair value $120.00 (range $80.00–$160.00), -64.0% vs current.
* Suggested accumulation zone near $90.00.
* Strength: 29%+ annual revenue growth to $2.17B

STRATEGY

Fundamental view supplies the core bearish driver with strong-sell rating and deep fair-value discount, while technicals add a neutral-to-weakening chart that still respects nearby EMA supports as logical exit rungs. Macro remains a mild headwind via dollar strength and lagging sector, supporting a modest short rather than aggressive size. Enter short near current price with stop above the $305 supply zone; scale out one-third at each descending EMA support. Invalidation occurs on a daily close above $305 that also lifts RSI divergences. Size at 1% risk of equity and stage entries only on any retest of $284-$285 if price bounces first.
